card.name: Words just before a case count
card.fires_on: The space or small word right before a number or count of patients or cases, such as 'from', 'a few', or 'cases of'. It appears in adverse-event and incidence sentences.

modes.label: Space before a percentage
modes.description: A blank token between a clause break and a percentage or count of patients with an event.
modes.example: None of these events were Grade 3 or 4 in the imatinib mesylate arm;<< >>0.7% were Grade 3

modes.label: Linking word before a number
modes.description: The word 'from' in a range, or 'a' or 'cases' introducing how many were affected.
modes.example: deaths from the administration of iodinated contrast agents range<< from>> 6.6 per 1 million

modes.label: Cases of an event
modes.description: The word 'cases' or 'Cases' just before 'of' plus a named adverse event.
modes.example: Mineralization Defects<< Cases>> of osteomalacia associated with proximal

card.writes: It suppresses sorting and grouping words and gives only a weak, mixed push toward sizing terms, so it has no clear effect on the output.
card.plain: It fires on the small word or gap just before a number of patients or cases is given in a side-effect sentence.
